answer.camera_language: Living, gently swaying coverage warms into slow approaches as interest grows; the closest approach belongs to the father's demand, then the camera eases back into reflective distance.

clips.motivation: Give the first shared exchange a human warmth without emphasizing physical contact.
clips.opens_on: Anudi left, Kasun right, phone extended centrally
clips.lands_on: Both waist up with the returned phone at Anudi's waist
clips.composition_note: Balance their inward eyelines across the central handover space; retain the vehicle behind Kasun.
clips.why: A visibly floating shared frame makes the encounter feel spontaneous while leaving the handover uncomplicated.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level waist-up two-shot, the subtle handheld frame gently floating and swaying through the handover and her thanks, easing as she finishes.

clips.direction: left along the phone's short path
clips.motivation: Follow the returned object into her possession without making the hands the emotional subject.
clips.opens_on: Phone centered between cream and faded blue sleeves
clips.lands_on: Phone and receiving hand slightly left of center
clips.composition_note: Use a short pan and retain room left for the final draw toward Anudi; focus covers the handset and receiving hand.
clips.why: A short, readable pan gives the object a tactile introduction that will contrast with the later fixed caller display.
clips.camera_sentence: Waist-height oblique insert, the camera slowly pans left with the phone as she receives it, then comes to rest.

clips.motivation: Keep his reassurance relaxed and personal rather than formally presented.
clips.opens_on: Kasun chest and head on the right third, looking left
clips.lands_on: Kasun in the same chest-up portrait
clips.composition_note: Maintain open space left and the softly resolved vehicle behind his right shoulder.
clips.why: His modest answer needs living coverage, not an emphatic camera gesture.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level medium close-up, the subtle handheld frame gently floating and swaying around his eyeline as he answers, easing afterward.

clips.trigger: her interested look toward the business
clips.motivation: Let her shift from gratitude to curiosity draw the audience closer.
clips.opens_on: Anudi waist up at left, phone low and vehicle edge in right depth
clips.lands_on: Anudi chest up with room toward her rightward eyeline
clips.composition_note: Keep Anudi left and preserve a trace of the vehicle edge as the waist-up frame tightens.
clips.why: The first approach belongs to her genuine curiosity, not to the mechanics of returning the phone.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level medium shot, the camera slowly pushes toward a medium close-up as her interested look becomes a question.

clips.trigger: her offscreen question about the business
clips.motivation: Study the modest business with the same unforced attention she gives it.
clips.opens_on: Medium view of the three-wheeler through its soft near edge
clips.lands_on: A slightly closer medium view within the same foreground frame
clips.composition_note: Keep the near vehicle edge soft along one side; the short approach stays wholly within the established business view.
clips.why: A short creep turns the business into something being considered rather than an inert explanatory insert.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level medium detail, the camera creeps very slowly forward as her question continues offscreen, easing to rest within the foreground framing.

clips.motivation: Preserve equality as his answer leads naturally into her next question.
clips.opens_on: Anudi left and Kasun right, both waist up
clips.lands_on: The same shared waist-up frame with business behind Kasun
clips.composition_note: Keep the central conversational space balanced rather than favoring either speaker.
clips.why: Returning to the same gently swaying shared frame makes their growing ease feel mutual.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level waist-up two-shot, the subtle handheld frame gently floating and swaying between their eyelines through the exchange, easing afterward.

clips.trigger: L7, his account of starting alone
clips.motivation: Give increasing weight to the hope beneath his modest account.
clips.opens_on: Kasun chest and head on the right third
clips.lands_on: Kasun in close-up, still looking left
clips.composition_note: Maintain the right-third placement and leftward speaking space as the business softens behind him.
clips.why: A measured approach honors his ambition without turning the speech into a heroic announcement.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level medium close-up, the camera slowly pushes toward a close-up as he explains his beginnings and hopes, easing as he finishes.

clips.direction: slightly down and right toward the raised screen
clips.trigger: the phone rings and she raises it
clips.motivation: Let the interruption enter the existing close frame rather than announcing it with a dramatic flourish.
clips.opens_on: Anudi's face upper left and phone low right
clips.lands_on: Face upper left and raised caller display foreground right
clips.composition_note: Make only a small corrective reframe, retaining both the face and phone within the existing close composition.
clips.why: A practical correction allows the call to interrupt her admiration without prematurely stating its emotional meaning.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level close-up, the camera slowly reframes slightly down and right as the ringing phone rises, then settles.

clips.motivation: Make the caller's identity an unambiguous, fixed interruption to their living exchange.
clips.opens_on: Phone display filling the frame with Father readable
clips.lands_on: The same incoming-call display and supporting right hand
clips.composition_note: Align the focus plane with the display so the whole caller label remains sharp.
clips.why: This deliberate stillness gives the readable caller display the authority to interrupt the scene.
clips.camera_sentence: High-oblique extreme close-up, the camera holds completely still on the incoming-call display.

clips.trigger: she brings the phone to her ear
clips.motivation: Keep the greeting ordinary before the call's meaning becomes clear.
clips.opens_on: Anudi head and shoulders at left, phone raised
clips.lands_on: Anudi in the same portrait with phone at her ear
clips.composition_note: Retain the left-third placement, rightward space and umbrella edge overhead.
clips.why: The familiar greeting should retain the scene's human movement rather than telegraphing bad news.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level medium close-up, the operated frame gently floating and swaying as she raises the phone and greets her father, easing afterward.

clips.trigger: L11, her father begins his directive
clips.motivation: Make the father's pressure register through increasing proximity to the listener.
clips.opens_on: Anudi's face and phone in close-up at left
clips.lands_on: A tighter close-up of Anudi's face and phone
clips.composition_note: Use the scene's longest approach, tightening within CU while preserving rightward space and the established eyeline.
clips.why: The strongest approach belongs to the demand that changes the encounter, and it stays entirely with its listener.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level close-up, the camera slowly pushes closer as her father's demand unfolds, then comes to rest on her listening face.

clips.direction: toward Anudi through the umbrella-edge framing
clips.motivation: Separate her emotionally from the roadside while the family pressure continues.
clips.opens_on: Three-quarter MCU, Anudi left with soft umbrella edge above
clips.lands_on: A closer MCU with the same open space right
clips.composition_note: Keep the umbrella edge peripheral and soft, maintaining MCU throughout the short approach.
clips.why: This shallower approach sustains the pressure without exceeding the preceding close-up's emphasis.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level three-quarter medium close-up, the camera creeps very slowly closer as she listens, remaining a medium close-up and easing to rest.

clips.motivation: Let the emotional change and subdued response carry the moment without another approach.
clips.opens_on: Anudi's face and phone in close-up
clips.lands_on: The same close-up after her reply
clips.composition_note: Keep the left-third placement and phone beside her face; allow visible but unhurried frame sway.
clips.why: With the pressure already established, living close coverage gives her compliance room to hurt without underlining it.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level close-up, the operated frame gently floats and sways very slowly as her smile fades and she replies, easing as she finishes.

clips.direction: balanced across the space between them
clips.trigger: she lowers the phone and returns her attention to Kasun
clips.motivation: Restore their shared space while allowing the altered mood to remain visible.
clips.opens_on: Anudi left with phone at ear, Kasun right
clips.lands_on: Both waist up facing each other, phone lowered
clips.composition_note: Recover exactly the earlier shared balance, now with slower frame sway rather than a new emphasis.
clips.why: The familiar two-shot lets the audience feel what has changed without giving Kasun knowledge of the call.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level waist-up two-shot, the subtle handheld frame gently floats and sways very slowly as she returns to him and takes her leave.

clips.direction: slightly left into Kasun's looking space
clips.trigger: his eyes dip and return to Anudi
clips.motivation: Give his quiet observation a private, attentive quality without suggesting comprehension of the call.
clips.opens_on: Kasun's face at right with negative space left
clips.lands_on: Kasun in close-up with slightly more open space left
clips.composition_note: Limit lateral travel to preserve the face at right and the soft vehicle behind.
clips.why: A small visible drift gives his concern life while refusing to turn it into a revelation.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level close-up, the camera drifts very slowly left into his looking space as his gaze dips and returns, then eases to rest.

clips.motivation: Keep his parting words simple and considerate after the interruption.
clips.opens_on: Kasun chest and head at right, looking left
clips.lands_on: The same chest-up portrait after his farewell
clips.composition_note: Repeat the original Kasun portrait with leftward space and a soft vehicle background.
clips.why: Returning to his original living portrait keeps the farewell warm without adding romantic certainty.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level medium close-up, the subtle handheld frame gently floats and sways very slowly as he offers his farewell, easing afterward.

clips.motivation: Let the shared encounter give way to the distance between their separate lives.
clips.opens_on: Both full figures, Anudi left and Kasun right with the vehicle behind
clips.lands_on: A looser wide view of the separated paths and wet roadside
clips.composition_note: Retreat a short distance without favoring either path; keep Kasun's hesitation and the vehicle within the same geography.
clips.why: A restrained withdrawal lets his lingering attention remain visible while the scene begins to release them.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level wide shot, the camera slowly pulls back as their paths separate, easing to rest as he reaches the business.

clips.direction: back across the wet roadside foreground
clips.trigger: their continued retreat along opposite depth paths
clips.motivation: Leave the encounter resonating in the growing empty space between them.
clips.opens_on: Wide roadside with Anudi small at left depth and Kasun at right depth
clips.lands_on: Extreme wide with expanded wet foreground and separated figures
clips.composition_note: Expand the central foreground while retaining both depth paths and the three-wheeler at right.
clips.why: Continuing the backward movement gives the ending a quiet afterimage rather than a second emotional climax.
clips.camera_sentence: Eye-level wide shot, the camera slowly pulls back to an extreme wide as they recede along opposite paths, then comes to rest.

notes: 4K-1: lens 85mm macro -> 85mm (the frame brief must follow)
4J-1: lens 100mm macro -> 100mm (the frame brief must follow)
